prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results.
No clear effect was seen for home, wait_info changes, as both tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence for sign_in, reorder changes is still thin because the two tests do not agree after noise correction.
Evidence for adoption, redesign changes is still thin with only one test conducted.
Evidence for sign_in, copy changes is still thin with only one test conducted.
Evidence for finish, redesign, choose_path, hint, and home, notification changes is still thin with only one test conducted each.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Add pet preview verification step before adoption certificate: Insert a new screen showing a 3D rendered preview of the pet before confirming adoption. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
1: [adoption, hint] Photo upload lighting and pose guidance hint: Add an explicit guidance hint on the photo upload screen recommending bright lighting and clear front angles. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation looking wrong or failing.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop status engine initialization notice: Update the waiting screen text to clearly explain desktop engine loading status. (why: Home step has a long mean time (2336s) and support has 3 tickets reporting pets not appearing on desktop.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account sync reassurance copy on sign-in screen: Update sign-in headline and hint to assure users that signing in preserves pet state across sessions. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) involves pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [finish, notification] Enable desktop readiness completion notification: Set desktop system notification when finishing home intro so users know the pet is active on desktop. (why: Users get confused after setup about whether the pet is active (3 support emails).)
5: [choose_path, layout] Split layout for narrative story screen: Switch story screen layout to a split layout showing story text alongside a visual pet mascot. (why: 76.2% conversion with long mean time (514s) indicates narrative content needs cleaner visual split structure.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official adoption badge incentive on certificate screen: Add a prominent official pet parent badge to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion (69.8%) and high mean completion time (1017s).)
